001: Haoran, did you go to literature class yesterday?
Yes, I did. The teacher's lecture was really interesting.
Really? What did she talk about?
She mainly analyzed a short story by Lu Xun.
Then next time I'll go and listen too.
Sounds good. Let's go together next Monday.
002: Tingting, what elective course did you choose?
I chose psychology. I heard it's really interesting.
Does that class have a lot of homework?
Not too much. We just have to write a reflection every week.
That sounds pretty easy. I want to take it too.
Then you should hurry and check the system.
003: Zixuan, did you bring your textbook?
Oh no, I left it in the dorm.
What are you going to do? The teacher said she would check.
Let me see if I can borrow one from someone.
I brought an extra copy. I'll lend it to you.
Thank you so much. I'll treat you to milk tea later.
004: Did you understand today's history class?
I understood most of it, but I was a bit sleepy.
Did you stay up late again last night?
Yeah, I was rushing to finish my homework until two in the morning.
No wonder you had no energy in class. You need to get more rest.
You're right. I'll definitely go to bed early tonight.
005: Jingyi, do you think this class is hard?
The difficulty is okay, but there's a lot of content.
I'm having a bit of trouble keeping up with the teacher's pace.
Do you want to study together? I can help you.
That would be great. When should we meet?
Let's meet at the library tomorrow afternoon.
006: Tianyou, did the teacher take attendance just now?
Yes, she did. Good thing you made it in time.
There was traffic on the way. I almost arrived late.
Next time, it's safer to leave earlier.
Yeah, I'll remember that. I'll leave earlier from now on.
By the way, don't forget to bring your calculator to the next class.
007: Jiaqi, what do you think of the teacher's teaching style?
It's pretty good, but she talks a bit fast.
I think so too. I can't even keep up with my notes.
I recorded the lecture. Do you want to listen to it?
That's great. Send me a copy.
No problem. I'll send it to you later.
008: Junjie, why didn't you go to class today?
I caught a cold, so I'm resting in the dorm.
Then what are you going to do about the class content?
I plan to borrow a classmate's notes and take a look.
I took notes on the key points for you. I'll give them to you later.
Thank you so much. You really saved me.
009: Yuxuan, how do you think the final exam for this class will be?
The teacher said there will be a written test and a group presentation.
How many people are in a group for the presentation?
I think it's four people per group, and we can form our own teams.
Then let's be in a group together. That's exactly four people.
Sounds good. Let's discuss the topic later.
010: Haoran, do you usually sit in the front or the back in class?
I like sitting in the front. I can hear more clearly.
Me too. Sitting in the back makes me zone out easily.
Plus, in the front you can interact with the teacher more.
Right, and it's easier to answer when the teacher asks questions.
Then let's sit together next time.
